summary: RETEST PASSED. The one-line fix in admin_portal.py:564 (`files: List[UploadFile] = File(default_factory=list)`) unblocks the entire multi-file feature. All 12 pytest scenarios in test_task_submissions_multi_file.py pass (12/12). Playwright E2E verified end-to-end: student logged in, navigated to course `Música`, opened a task with delivery_type='both', uploaded 3 files via [data-testid='file-input'] (with multiple attribute), saw all 3 in [data-testid='selected-files-list'], clicked [data-testid='submit-task-btn'], received success modal '¡Tarea Entregada!' and the 3 attachments are rendered in the submission area. Files were stored via Cloudinary fallback (Drive not connected) as expected.

minor.issue: Unrelated pre-existing bug — `create_system_support_user(db, school_id)` signature mismatch. Out of scope per request.

issues: Modal shows 'Guardado en Google Drive' regardless of actual storage backend. Since Drive is not connected and files go via Cloudinary fallback, this message is misleading. Consider switching label to 'Guardado correctamente' or 'Guardado en {storage_type}'.

action_items: (Optional polish) Make the post-submit modal label reflect actual storage_type returned by backend (Cloudinary vs Google Drive) instead of hard-coded 'Guardado en Google Drive'.
(Out of scope) Fix /api/schools/create create_system_support_user signature so future testing agents can create isolated schools.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_portal.py:564 fix is correct and canonical FastAPI pattern for multi-file uploads.

delivery_type metadata values must be one of 'text' | 'files' | 'both' for the StudentCourseDetailPage frontend to render the file upload UI (line 2256). Spanish labels like 'Texto y archivos' should NOT be sent from API — they are derived in the frontend via getDeliveryTypeLabel(). The CreatePostModal (admin/teacher) appears to use the correct codes already; just worth a sanity check.
Frontend correctly appends 'files' parts in FormData (multiple) and renders selected-files-list + existing-submission-files / existing-submission-download-btn-N as expected.

rca of the issue: Resolved in iteration_202. RCA: signature `files: Optional[List[UploadFile]] = File(None)` was incompatible with FastAPI multipart parsing under Pydantic v2 — each UploadFile was validated against the List schema and rejected with 422 list_type. Fix: `files: List[UploadFile] = File(default_factory=list)` — confirmed present at admin_portal.py:564 and validated by passing 12/12 tests.
